• Standard (no Shizuku): Uses the AlarmManager API. Zero battery impact; works for most users. Recommended unless another app (e.g. Samsung Clock) schedules its alarms differently.\n\n• Shizuku: Reads alarm details via dumpsys. Useful when AlarmManager cannot identify the correct app\'s alarm. When enabled, a refresh is triggered on alarm-change events and once per 15 minutes when you return to your home screen — keeping the widget up to date only when it is visible.
Show clock app name as subtitle
This plugin adds a Smartspacer Target and Complication that show the next alarm from your chosen clock app(s).\n\nAdd the \'Next Alarm\' target or complication in Smartspacer settings to get started.
